seoTitle: Hawaii Public Schools Calendar 2027-2028: Holidays, Breaks & PDF
seoDescription: View the Hawaii public schools 2027-2028 calendar with first day, last day, Fall Break, Winter Break, Spring Break, state holidays, PDF and ICS download.
calendarNotes: The Hawaii State Department of Education 2027-2028 school calendar lists August 2, 2027 as the first day for students and May 24, 2028 as the last day for students. Fall Break runs October 4-8, 2027, Winter Break runs December 20-31, 2027, and Spring Break runs March 13-17, 2028. The calendar includes 180 student days, 189 teacher days, state holidays, a January 3 teacher workday, and an institute day window during October 18-22.

calendarFaqs.q: When does Hawaii public school start in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Hawaii public school students start the 2027-2028 school year on Monday, August 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Fall Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Fall Break runs Monday, October 4 through Friday, October 8, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Winter Break in 2027-2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs Monday, December 20 through Friday, December 31, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is Hawaii public schools Spring Break in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs Monday, March 13 through Friday, March 17, 2028.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of school for Hawaii public schools in 2028?
calendarFaqs.a: The last day for students is Wednesday, May 24, 2028.
